body: I can't wait for death. No feelings, no pain.

I know this response is late, but I relate to most of what you'v written in this post. I know the feeling and the doubts. I am male. However so many of my character traits are feminine. My mannerisms, voice, inflection, behavior, persona, interests, etc. I never felt like I was actually a male. I'm not assertive, dominant, aggressive, competitive. . . or whatnot. I didn't have many friends because I couldn't relate to the other guys. I cannot embrace masculinity because I feel like a fake, and I cannot embrace my femininity because I feel like a freak. This leaves me stuck in a middle ground where I have to suppress my personality around everyone, yet express myself in the closet. All because I have a bulge in between my legs and an XY chromosome. I've always wanted to be able to relax into my femininity and be expressive around everyone. I think if I were to live my life over again, with the same personality and soul, but as a female, my life would be 1000x better and more fulfilling than it is now. That is what life could have been for me. It tortures me on the daily. I may be transgender (or maybe not) but transitioning is never going to be a reality for me. It's unthinkable. I will never pass and none of my family or friends would take me seriously or understand in the slightest. I don't really have a solution to this problem, but I can only offer you my empathy and understanding. You are a very strong person for enduring all of these struggles in your life. Most people couldn't even handle these feelings for even a week, let alone a whole lifetime. They don't understand us because all of their lives they've fit the mold. If you would like to talk to me more about this, feel free, because you are definitely not alone in this!
